camel_example: aliyun alb ReplaceServersInServerGroup --region cn-hangzhou --RemovedServers.1.ServerId 'i-bp1f9kdprbgy9uiu0000' --AddedServers.1.ServerType Ecs --RemovedServers.1.ServerType ecs --AddedServers.1.ServerId 'i-bp1f9kdprbgy9uiu0000' --AddedServers.1.Description test --AddedServers.1.ServerIp '192.168.1.1' --ServerGroupId 'sgp-5114d593o96qxy0000' --RemovedServers.1.Port 81 --AddedServers.1.Port 80 --AddedServers.1.Weight 100 --RemovedServers.1.ServerIp '192.168.1.12' --method POST --force
description_en: Replaces backend servers in a backend server group
description_zh: 替换后端服务器组中的后端服务器
kebab_example: aliyun alb replace-servers-in-server-group --server-group-id sgp-5114d593o96qxy0000 --added-servers ServerType=Ecs Description=test ServerId=i-bp1f9kdprbgy9uiu0000 Port=80 ServerIp=192.168.1.1 Weight=100 --removed-servers ServerType=ecs ServerId=i-bp1f9kdprbgy9uiu0000 ServerIp=192.168.1.12 Port=81 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReplaceServersInServerGroup

parameters.help_en:
The server group ID.

Server groups of the Function Compute type do not support replacing backend servers
parameters.help_zh:
服务器组ID。

函数计算类型的服务器组不支持替换后端服务器
parameters.name: server_group_id

fields.help_en: The description of the backend server. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 后端服务器描述。长度为 2~256 个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The port used by the backend server group. Valid values: 1 to 65535. You can specify up to 200 servers in a single request
fields.help_zh: 后端服务器组使用的端口。取值范围：1~65535。单次调用最多支持传入200个服务器
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The backend server ID. You can specify up to 200 servers in a single request.

If the server group type is Instance, set this parameter to the ID of an Ecs, Eni, or Eci resource.

If the server group type is Ip, set this parameter to an IP address.

Server groups of the Function Compute type do not support replacing backend servers. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213627.html to query the server group type
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器ID。单次调用最多支持传入200个服务器。

当服务器组为Instance类型时，该参数为Ecs、Eni、Eci资源ID。

当服务器组为Ip类型时，该参数为IP地址。

函数计算类型的服务器组不支持替换后端服务器。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213627.html接口获取服务器组类型的取值
fields.name: server_id

fields.help_en:
The IP address.

If ServerType is set to Eni, you can specify the primary private IP address or a secondary private IP address of the ENI
fields.help_zh:
指定IP地址。

当ServerType为Eni时，支持指定ENI的主私网IP或辅助私网IP
fields.name: server_ip

Eni: ENI network interface controller (NIC) instance.
Eci: ECI elastic container.
Ip: IP address.
Fc: Function Compute

Eni：ENI弹性网卡实例。

fields.help_en:
The weight of the backend server. You can specify up to 200 servers in a single request.

Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 100. If the weight is set to 0, no requests are forwarded to the backend server

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without replacing backend servers in the server group. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business limitations. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an `HTTP 2xx` status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会替换服务器组中的后端服务器。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回`HTTP 2xx`状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run
